why: The vantage's repaint widened four hundred blocks east and west, far past every placed piece. `fillbiome` into a chunk nothing loads is a silent no-op, so most of the volume would keep its old sky with every proof green. The map's extent exists only once the pieces are placed, so this is refused by `delvec build`. It declares no unit: `region` is bound by the vantage's own repaint.
